name: Omniscio
where_agents_run: your machine, or a remote host over SSH per session; Devin runs in Cognition's cloud; phone reaches it via browser (same Wi-Fi, or Tailscale)
license: Closed source; free plan, Pro $15/month or $144/year (early access free)
source_note: Checked against docs.omniscio.com (full docs page, v0.1.108), its features, roadmap, download, EULA and terms pages, the homepage, and installer file sizes. No public source repo. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Devin side by side

needs_you_signal.value: Needs-you inbox, desktop alerts, phone push, SMS, Telegram

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve or decline in the app, by phone, SMS or Telegram

cross_provider_delegation.value: Agents spawn sessions on any engine, linked back to parent

always_on_assistant.value: Voice assistant (off by default) and ask-about-this-page

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat view with plain-English rewrite of replies

real_terminal.value: Chat only; its terminal is for your own commands

session_organization.value: Folders with sessions, groups, tags, inbox view

prompt_scratchpad.value: Unsent drafts per session; no drafts pad

saved_prompt_library.value: Prompt template library and saved quick replies

builtin_editors_browser.value: File viewer and editor, diff viewer, AI browser, shell

appearance_control.value: 13 skins, custom themes, light or dark, font size

usage_hud.value: Claude 5-hour and weekly use per account, plus costs

burn_rate_forecast.value: Predicts when each Claude account hits its 5-hour limit

limit_governor.value: Waits at a limit and resumes after reset; no early pause

account_hotswap.value: Several Claude logins; switches when one hits its limit

vault_task_source.value: Opens your Obsidian vault; tasks live in its own lists

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Jira issues start agents; no issue-to-PR flow

worktree_management.value: Optional worktree per session, merged back when done

planner_orchestrator.value: Multi-step recipes, including split into parallel sessions

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents send messages into other sessions via its local API

knowledge_base.value: Agent memory store and a notes vault agents read and write

native_mobile_app.value: Not in app stores; installable web app instead

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone browser on same Wi-Fi, or anywhere via Tailscale

remote_ssh.value: Run any session's Claude on an SSH host

voice_input.value: Wake word, dictation and voice commands

os.value: Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon, Intel), Linux AppImage; phone browser

background_process.value: Yes: local control server (port 19519) and phone web server

download_size.value: v0.1.108: 461 MB Windows setup, 570-577 MB macOS dmg, 579 MB Linux AppImage

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app with many built-in services; recommends 16 GB RAM)

license_cost.value: Closed source; Free plan, Pro $15/month; early access free

extensibility.value: Plugin SDK and marketplace, local HTTP API, skills, MCP

teams_multiuser.value: Team chat and shared workspaces; SSO not yet, SCIM off

stability_maturity.value: v0.1.108, early access, releases since April 2026
